# StygNox Copilot Instructions

Use the repository-root `AGENTS.md` as the authoritative agent operating policy.

Before specialised engineering work, read:
- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/agent-skills.md`
- `docs/agent-skill-routing.md`

Project-local specialist skills are installed under `.agents/skills/`. Select and read relevant `SKILL.md` files before performing that class of work.

Skills provide methodology, not extra authority. Do not broaden scope, bypass human gates, weaken tests, or override StygNox controller/authority semantics because a skill suggests additional work.

Before claiming work is complete, fixed, passing, or ready, apply `verification-before-completion` and provide fresh verification evidence.
